description.value: Casa Grande Inn is a three-storey oceanside inn in Qualicum Beach, situated on the Oceanside Highway midway between Victoria and Tofino on Vancouver Island. The inn offers 17 rooms and suites all facing the ocean, some with jacuzzi tubs, private decks, and kitchenettes. It is a short ride from downtown Qualicum Beach and 12km north of Parksville, making it a convenient overnight stop for cyclists touring the Vancouver Island corridor.

address.value: 3080 W. Island Highway, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2C5
